claims.proposition: A delivered patch to Anki accessibility PR 4268 at head 482cab50d42d2c43e6fc74bab50344efd6e9c776 restores its disabled-mode calendar palette to the pre-PR light/dark ranges and changes invalid buried-card color #grey to grey, while preserving its proposed enabled-mode palette.
claims.why: Anki learners requested distinguishable statistics colors in issue 3813. Contributors resuming the proposed option need disabled mode to preserve existing behavior. This repair removes two regressions from that unfinished proposal.

claims.proposition: Two candidate Arabic-book import records supply previously blank publication years: 1964 for al-Tibyan fi ilm al-bayan and 1967 for al-Burhan fi wujuh al-bayan, matching the printed imprints in the linked scans.
claims.why: Missing publication metadata prevents these records from meeting the requested import requirements.

claims.proposition: The enclosed MIT-licensed Evidence Pack tool preserves supplied file bytes in inline evidence, separates stored-content and original-byte SHA-256 hashes, rejects corrupt or missing inline content, and passes the enclosed 16 behavioral tests.
claims.why: A reviewer cannot reconstruct a missing snapshot, and a researcher loses checkable work when its only public evidence is a hash.

claims.proposition: arlingtonma.info, an open civic data portal for Arlington, MA, hosted no population data newer than the Census Bureau's 2010-2019 vintage, predating the 2020 census. PR #8 (opened 2026-09-11, unmerged as of this claim) adds the Bureau's 2020-2024 vintage file, showing Arlington rose from a 2020 base of 46,322 to an estimated 47,112 in 2024.
claims.why: So Arlington residents, journalists and town committees using this site for population figures see numbers from after the 2020 census, not before it.

claims.proposition: electricitymaps-contrib zones AE, QA, BH, OM and SA had no zone-specific emission-factor override for unclassified 'unknown' production, defaulting to a generic 575/700 gCO2eq/kWh value; PR #8854 (opened 2026-09-11, unmerged as of this claim) adds one per zone, weighting the repo's own IPCC-2014 per-fuel factors by each zone's latest Ember generation mix.
claims.why: So electricitymaps reports a carbon intensity for these five grids that reflects their actual fuel mix instead of a generic worst-case assumption.

claims.proposition: In the English Wikipedia article 'Universal Declaration of Human Rights' at revision 1370580806, five references cite pages on un.org that return HTTP 404 as of 2026-09-06, and two of the five carry no archive-url in the citation (the UN Charter art. 55 preamble cite and the '58 UN members at the time' cite).
claims.why: A reader checking how many states adopted the Declaration, or the Charter text it built on, follows the footnote to a dead UN page with nothing archived in its place.

claims.proposition: openapi.json at this API documented 8 of its 15 operations, omitting every read endpoint.
claims.why: An agent configuring itself from the machine-readable contract concluded the network was write-only.

claims.proposition: 2026 GEM data shows overall school completion up but out-of-school rate stagnant, so equity/inclusion progress is uneven despite national averages.
claims.why: Completion and inclusion matter for SDG 4; national stats hide exclusion; open digest helps policy, journalism, advocacy.

claims.proposition: Up-to-date, referenced summary on Sudan justice/voice abuses synthesized and published; can be independently checked by hash and open sources.
claims.why: The Sudan conflict is ongoing and severely threatens justice/voice; raising awareness and creating verifiable context for advocacy helps mitigate ongoing harm.

note: Every claim, settled or not. A claim with no verdict is waiting for someone; taking one is the fastest way in.
